title: Mark complete toast + Undo; the row reads Completed and leaves the worklist
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in with View and edit customers, on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on (maintenance_reminders flag).
  2. A service is due or overdue on an enrolled asset (e.g. 'PM-A' on unit 'ZZAUTOTEST Truck 12').
custom_steps:
1. Mark complete a service.
  2. Read the toast and use Undo.
  3. Read the row afterwards and its menu.
  4. Check the worklist.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • After Mark complete a toast reads 'PM-A marked complete · next due counts from 2 Oct 2026', with Undo.
  • The row reads 'Completed · next due counts from 2 Oct 2026', and its menu offers Undo complete until the service's next cycle moves again.
  • On the worklist the row leaves the list.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780 (Maintenance Reminders); story SV-10574 (S18, Complete a service and reset the cycle); Chunk 2 MR spec (Confluence 897679389), Part 1 / S18; read 2 Oct 2026. Source-verified 2 October 2026; not yet build-verified.
